title: Page 7
lines: 在其他几个巨棺中，又接连找着一堆武器和毒药跟蛊虫后，傅衡盖上棺盖，突然有了点危机意识。
“师姊，你觉得在咱们知道这秘密后……那位祭司会轻易让咱们跑了吗？”
绝对不会！
月穹赶紧拉着他出了墓室走回地道里，“出口在哪？”
“就只有身后和眼前的这条。”不过后头的追兵应该已经快追上来了。
空旷的地道中，庞杂脚步声听来格外地响亮，月穹没料到来者的速度竟然那么快，而她也没时间一直耗在这里，或是被请去云取宫参与什么神宫的内斗。
“师姊？”跟在她身后的傅衡在她突然停下来时，差点就撞歪了鼻子。
她将身上所有的随身毒药都塞给他。
“我赶着回去救人，小七，你留在这儿替我挡他们一阵。”反正他也是相级高手，加上打小运气就好，相信这回他定也能化险为夷的。
“什么？”
“就当我欠你一次。”月穹万事拜托地按着他的肩，“待我相公没事后我就回来救你，你记得一定要撑着点替我拦住他们！”
随着黑夜的过去，当月穹离开丛山来到云取宫的势力范围外，浴沐在阳光下并攀上马背时，傅衡正站在秘庄底下的地牢里，两手握着铁栏对着外头大叫。
“师姊！你太无耻了——”
刻意牺牲了傅衡当人质，月穹怀中揣着玉盒策马急驰，一路不合眼不休息，当天夜里，文府饱受煎熬的众人，终于等到了她这个希望。
回府看过文谨的情况后，月穹便闭门专心制她的解药去了，待到天亮时，她也不管刚出炉的药泥还烫热，十指被烫得通红的她照样把它搓成药丸，然后把它塞进文谨的嘴里。
确定文谨体内的毒性正在慢慢消解，月穹强撑着眼皮，把其他也累得快睁不开眼的人都打发回去休息，然后她拉了张小椅坐在床畔，半趴在文谨的身边，仔细地看着睡得很熟的他。
看过无数男人，她就没见过比他还傻的。
偏偏这个傻瓜爱她。
她的指尖悄悄划过他的鼻梢，再滑到常常笑得温柔的嘴角，然后往上抚过那一双总是写满爱意的眼眸。
一直以来，她怎么会把他的爱视为理所当然？他不欠她的。
而她又怎么会没发现到，他的一举一动，总是刻意在配合着她性子，并且时时迁就着她？
该说二师兄太会替她挑男人吗？这个缺爱又缺老婆的男人，打从一开始就把姿态压得低得不能再低，小心翼翼地捧着真心，就盼她能回应一点他所付出的爱意。
可同样也是这个呆子，老认为她没回应也没感觉，他以为每个人都可以跟她一块儿在床上研究书中的姿势吗？更不要说他动不动的搂搂亲亲，还有夜夜的同床共枕……天底下有这资格的，就只有他一人而已。
“你哪只眼瞧见我是个心思单纯好拐骗的？”她边说边弹着他的鼻子玩，“你钓着我，我又何尝不是在钓着你？”要不是认准他这人，她早逃婚去了，他们又哪会有今日？
指下的力道不小心大了点，将他的鼻子弹得有些红……月穹赶紧替他揉了揉，也不知怎地，为他奔波那么久，她一点都不累，也不觉得苦，可现在这般静静看着他，她却有种想哭的冲动。
“要我爱人不难，可我从没想要你拿命来换。”她把脸埋进他的颈间，带着丝丝的哭意对他道：“醒过来吧，就像你说过的，今后咱们好好过日子……”
彷佛睡上瘾的文谨，在服下解药两日后，终于在众人的期待下掀开了眼帘。
月穹关上房门，将那群又哭又笑的人给挡在门外，接着她面无表情地坐在床边问。
“还疼不疼？”
文谨摸摸胸口，“有点。”
“有力气吗？”
“好像没有……”他试着动了动，却觉得浑身酸疼乏力。
“嗯，那你看着。”月穹点点头，把他的脸转过来朝向她后，她立刻就赏了自己一记重重的耳光。
清亮的巴掌声，当下惊醒了还犹有睡意的文谨，他直瞪着她脸上的巴掌印。
“媳妇你做什么？”
月穹接下来的动作是……抬手轻轻赏他一记耳光。
“……娘子？”为什么他也有福同享？
她在他不解的目光下，爬上床舖不客气地坐上他的肚子，然后低下头，揪着他的衣领恶声恶气地道。
“往后无论做什么事都得先同我商量，不许再擅作主张，懂？”谁稀罕他为救妻奋不顾身的英勇行为啊？武功既没她高，那安安分分躲在她身后就是了，他逞什么英雄？简直就是欠揍！
“懂……”他呐呐的，还是头一回见她这么生气。
“都说百年后要躺一个棺，你是想提早六十年就把我装进去吗？”她愈想愈不解气，一想到他差点就告别这世上，她就又低头在他脸颊上咬了好几口。
“我再不敢了……”他忍不住缩着肩，因她真的咬得很用力。
“你要再敢我就剥了你的皮，还把你的裸画贴得满大街都是！”没见过泼妇是不是？今日她就为他演绎一下什么叫河东狮吼。
文谨目光瞬也不瞬地看着正在他身上撒泼的她，一开始，丝丝的笑意只是跃上他的唇角，后来他也不知怎地，明知她还在冒火他就是忍不住，不但对她绽开笑容，还笑得前所未有的开怀和灿烂。
“笑什么笑，知不知道你险些就死了？”她在说教他居然还给她走神？
“娘子，你的心中有我。”他终于确定了，这个嘴上从不会挂着情情爱爱的女人，她对他是真心的。
月穹真想揍他几拳，“这不是废话？”
“为夫今日才知道。”他照样咧笑着嘴，好心情一点都不受她的母夜叉样影响。
“那是你太迟钝了好吗？”都老老实实的跟他一块儿过日子这么久，他却直到现在才想通。
文谨费力地把张牙舞爪的她拉下来，让她趴在他的身上，再两手环住她的腰将她抱紧。
“只要你没事就好……”
她还在抱怨，“我比你强。”
“再强也是我妻子。”他亲吻着她的发丝，手指摸上她被打红的脸颊，“我管不住我自己，我就是想要保护你……”当时他什么也没想，下意识就扑过去了，这真怪不得他。
“下回再有这种情况，你就躲一边凉快去吧，要对娘子我有信心知道吗？”
“是。”他向来就很遵从妻命。
趴在他胸膛上听着他规律的心音，月穹觉得她这阵子原本空洞洞的胸口，好像又被什么给重新填满了，她不甘心地再捏捏他的鼻子，然后翻身下床。
“好了，起来喝药。”文伯应该在外面捧着药汤等很久了。
等到文伯进房服侍他喝完药汤，门外早就等着的弟弟们，在月穹的放行下，一个个先后冲去床边对着文谨抹眼泪，文谨才勉强应付完这一轮，下一波前来探视的长辈们，已接着踏进房里来了。
直到所有人都散去，他也再次被月穹泡到药水里，文谨这才有心思回想这事的来龙去脉。
“是谁下的手？”难道是他生意上的仇家？
“云取宫的某个大祭司。”
“理由？”他可没得罪过那个神教。
“你用来讨我欢心的那两张魂纸。”她就知道那玩意儿不是好东西，就只会带来麻烦而已。
他很快即想通事情的始末，但也狐疑地扬起剑眉。
“你……哪来的解药？”不是听说神宫的毒只有神宫之人能解吗？
content_en:
After finding a bunch of weapons, poisons and Gu insects in several other giant coffins, Fu Heng closed the lid of the coffin and suddenly felt a sense of crisis.
"Sister, do you think that after we know this secret... the priest will let us run away easily?"
Absolutely not!
Yue Qiong quickly pulled him out of the tomb and back into the tunnel, "Where is the exit?"
"There's only one behind you and this one in front of you." But the pursuers behind him should have almost caught up.
In the empty tunnel, the sound of numerous footsteps sounded particularly loud. Yue Qiong did not expect the speed of the arrival to be so fast, and she did not have the time to spend here all the time, or be invited to Yuntori Palace to participate in some internal fighting in the shrine.
"Sister?" Fu Heng, who was following her, almost broke his nose when she suddenly stopped.
She gave him all the poison she had with her.
"I'm going back to save people, Xiaoqi, you stay here to block them for me for a while." Anyway, he is also a prime minister, and with a little luck, I believe he can save the day this time.
"What?"
"Just think that I owe you once." Yue Qiong pressed his shoulder with all the kindness, "I will come back to rescue you when my husband is fine. You must remember to hold on and stop them for me!"
As the night passed, when Yue Qiong left Congshan and came outside the sphere of influence of Yuntori Palace, basking in the sunshine and climbing on horseback, Fu Heng was standing in the dungeon under the secret village, holding the iron bars with both hands and shouting outside.
"Sister! You are so shameless-"
Deliberately sacrificing Fu Heng as a hostage, Yue Qiong galloped with a jade box in her arms, without closing her eyes or resting all the way. That night, everyone in the Wen Mansion who had suffered so much finally got their hope.
After returning home to see Wen Jin's condition, Yue Qiong closed the door and concentrated on making her antidote. When dawn came, she didn't care that the mud was still hot. Her fingers were red from the heat, she rolled it into pills, and then stuffed it into Wen Jin's mouth.
After confirming that the poison in Wen Jin's body was slowly dissipating, Yue Qiong forced her eyelids open and sent the others who were too tired to open their eyes to rest. Then she pulled up a small chair and sat beside the bed, half-lying beside Wen Jin, and carefully looked at him who was sleeping soundly.
She has seen countless men, but she has never seen anyone stupider than him.
But this fool loved her.
Her fingertips quietly crossed the tip of his nose, then slid to the corner of his mouth where he often smiled softly, and then moved up to stroke the pair of eyes that were always full of love.
How could she take his love for granted all this time? He didn't owe her anything.
And how could she not notice that every move he made was always deliberately in line with her temperament and always accommodating her?
Should I say that the second senior brother is too good at choosing a man for her? This man who lacks love and a wife has kept his attitude as low as possible from the beginning, carefully holding his sincerity in his heart, hoping that she would respond to some of the love he has given her.
But he is also the same idiot who always thinks that she has no response and no feeling. Does he think that everyone can study the postures in the book with her in bed? Not to mention his constant cuddling and kissing, and sleeping in the same bed every night... He is the only one in the world who has such qualifications.
"Have you seen that I am a simple-minded person who is easy to deceive?" She said while flicking his nose, "You are fishing for me, how can I not be fishing for you?" If she had not identified him, she would have escaped from the marriage long ago, and how would they be today?
The force under her fingers was accidentally too strong, causing his nose to turn a little red... Yue Qiong quickly rubbed it for him. Somehow, after running for him for so long, she was not tired at all, nor did she feel bitter. But now, looking at him quietly like this, she had the urge to cry.
"It's not difficult to be my lover, but I never want you to sacrifice your life." She buried her face in his neck and said to him with a hint of tears: "Wake up, just like you said, let's live a good life from now on..."
Wen Jin, who seemed to be addicted to sleeping, finally opened his eyes to the expectation of everyone after taking the antidote for two days.
Yue Qiong closed the door, blocking out the group of crying and laughing people, and then she sat expressionlessly by the bed and asked.
"Does it still hurt?"
Wen Jin touched his chest and said, "A little bit."
"Do you have the strength?"
"It seems not..." He tried to move, but felt sore and weak all over.
"Well, then you watch." Yue Qiong nodded, and after turning his face towards her, she immediately gave herself a hard slap in the face.
The clear slap woke up Wen Jin, who was still sleepy, and he stared at the slap mark on her face.
"Daughter-in-law, what are you doing?"
Yue Qiong's next move was... to raise her hand and give him a gentle slap in the face.
"...Madam?" Why did he also share the blessing?
Under his puzzled gaze, she climbed up on the bed and sat on his stomach unceremoniously, then lowered her head, grabbed his collar and said angrily.
"No matter what you do in the future, you must discuss it with me first, and you are not allowed to make any arbitrary decisions, understand?" Who cares about his heroic behavior of risking his own life to save his wife? Since his martial arts skills are not as high as hers, he can just hide behind her. Why is he trying to be a hero? It simply deserves a beating!
"I understand..." He said, this was the first time he saw her so angry.
"They say that a coffin will be laid in a hundred years. Do you want to put me in it sixty years earlier?" The more she thought about it, the more frustrated she became. When she thought about how he almost left this world, she lowered her head and bit his cheek several times.
"I don't dare anymore..." He couldn't help but shrink his shoulders because she was biting really hard.
"If you dare again, I will skin you off and post your naked pictures all over the streets!" Have you ever seen a shrew? Today she will explain to him what Hedong Lion's Roar is.
Wen Jin looked at her who was acting playfully on him without blinking an eye. At first, a slight smile just appeared on the corner of his lips, but then he somehow couldn't help it, knowing that she was still angry.
"Why are you laughing? Do you know that you almost died?" She was preaching and he still distracted her?
"Madam, you have me in your heart." He finally confirmed that this woman who never talked about love and affection was sincere to him.
Yue Qiong really wanted to punch him a few times, "Isn't this nonsense?"
"My husband only found out today." He still grinned, his good mood not affected by her dominatrix-like attitude at all.
"That's because you're too slow, okay?" We have lived with him honestly for so long, but he didn't figure it out until now.
Wen Jin struggled to pull her down with all her teeth and claws, let her lie on top of him, then put his hands around her waist and hugged her tightly.
"As long as you're okay..."
She was still complaining, "I'm better than you."
"No matter how strong she is, she is still my wife." He kissed her hair and touched her red cheeks with his fingers, "I can't control myself, I just want to protect you..." He didn't think anything at the time, and subconsciously rushed over. No wonder he was.
"Next time this happens again, just hide away and cool off. You have to have confidence in me, madam, you know?"
"Yes." He always obeyed his wife's orders.
Lying on his chest and listening to his regular heartbeat, Yue Qiong felt that her empty chest seemed to be filled with something again. She reluctantly pinched his nose again, and then turned over and got out of bed.
"Okay, get up and take some medicine." Uncle Wen must have been waiting outside with the medicine soup for a long time.
Chapter 8(2)
When Uncle Wen came into the room to serve him and finish drinking the medicinal soup, the brothers who had been waiting outside the door rushed to the bedside to wipe their tears on Wen Jin one after another with Yue Qiong's permission. Wen Jin barely managed to finish this round. The next wave of elders who came to visit had already stepped into the room.
It wasn't until everyone dispersed and he was soaked in the potion by Yue Qiong again that Wen Jin could think about the whole story.
"Who did it?" Was it his business enemy?
"A certain high priest of Untori Palace."
"Reason?" He had never offended that religious sect.
"Those two soul papers you used to please me." She knew that those things were not good things, they would only bring trouble.
He quickly figured out the whole story, but he also raised his eyebrows suspiciously.
"Where did you... get the antidote?" Didn't you hear that only the people of the Shrine can cure the poison in the Shrine?
